residualIdentityAudit.note: These identities remain in the source residual audit because tariff publication still fails closed or they are already represented by cumulative plan entries that do not produce a safe new offer.

tariffBlockers.policy: Do not flatten or choose among heterogeneous connector tariffs for one EVSE. Do not publish a mapping whose pricing compiler fails.

convergenceRule: No additional publication is allowed unless a future snapshot, official operator inventory, or pricing model resolves identity/pricing ambiguity. Current deterministic residual iteration produced zero net additions with zero removals and zero unexpected changes.
continuation: On future refreshes, retain the cumulative final residual recovery plan and revalidate all stored mappings. Only add newly proven mappings; never discard validated mappings merely because they are no longer residual.
